prompt:
Independently review the SAME physical part IDs across four actual GLB views. For each VIEW you receive the untouched image and an overlay. Inspect every rectangle against visible pixels and the supplied role description, NOT merely its label. Distinct grasp portions must not be swapped or merged. Inspect signed arrows: origin -> tip must follow the supplied physical meaning; an active surface is not the entire body. Compare the SAME ID across views and report contradictions, occlusion, depth ambiguity or missing surfaces. Do not endorse unseen surfaces. Return JSON {"views":[{"view":0,"objects":{"<id>":{"verdict":"confirmed|rejected|unresolved","reason":"visual evidence"}}}, ...],"cross_view":{"<id>":{"verdict":"confirmed|rejected|unresolved","reason":"identity and direction across views","additional_views":["needed camera or detail, if any"]}}}. Exactly four views and every ID in each view and cross_view are required. Return confirmed across views only with at least TWO useful views of the same region and consistent signed directions. ROLES:
{"grip_lower_haft": {"role": "grasp_region", "description": "Leather-wrapped lower wooden shaft, clear of the blade"}, "grip_upper_haft": {"role": "grasp_region", "description": "Bare upper-middle wooden shaft, clear of the head and its sharp edge"}, "axe_head": {"role": "functional_region", "description": "Sharpened outward-facing cutting edge of the axe head", "direction_semantics": "From the body of the metal head outward toward its visible sharp curved blade edge, not toward the flat poll or down the handle."}}
